item.title: RimWorld Skills List — All Skills Explained (1.6 & Odyssey)
item.description: RimWorld colonists have 12 skills. Each affects how fast and how well they perform a type of work. This guide explains each skill for the current 1.6 / Odyssey version. All RimWorld Skills SkillWhat it does ShootingRanged weapon accuracy. MeleeClose combat and melee weapon crafting. ConstructionBuilding speed and quality. MiningRock mining and digging speed.
